witness.branch: Vehicle turned in front of a fire-station driveway, entrance or approaches.
witness.quote: No vehicle in front of the driveway, entrance or approaches to a fire station shall be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction.
witness.reason: The intended reversal near a crest can occur in front of a fire-station entrance. The prohibition device alone does not activate this ordinance.
required_context: Applicable LVMC jurisdiction and identified fire station.
Device's prohibited movement and governed route.
Entrance, driveway and approach geometry relative to the crest and turning route.
Establish municipal jurisdiction, fire-station identity and frontage, driveway, entrance and approach geometry.
Identify the device's prohibited movement and governed route separately from the ordinance's fire-station conditions.
Physically usable space for the intended reversal near the crest.
Preserve the unresolved meanings of 'in front of', 'approaches' and 'opposite direction' without numerical substitutes.
Preserve vehicle exclusions and unresolved municipal incorporation of the supplied definitions.
Provide usable turning space and document the crest, vehicle footprint and route throughout the reversal.
witness.subject_reason: The selected party operates a motor vehicle, supplying the ordinance's vehicle subject.
